objective: Determine whether one non-overlapping, count-bearing batted-ball composition block materially strengthens the shared PA foundation for HR and Hits without reopening spent selection or confirmation evidence.

forbidden_for_this_program: opposing pitcher, actual starter, lineup, team, venue, weather, or umpire
evidence_boundary.source: first 43740 certified 2023 rows of direct batter PA panel v3; extraction stops after that exact certified count
evidence_boundary.feature_cutoff: source game date strictly before target game date

representation.invariant: barrel + hard-hit-non-barrel + other measured BBE equals the shared measured-BBE denominator

models.legacy_overlap_comparator: same fixed CatBoost candidate feature family used in v3
models.composition_candidate: identical family and model parameters, replacing only overlapping batted-ball fields with the locked independent composition
simple_comparators: time-safe empirical-Bayes player rate with 200-PA prior

chronological_folds.algorithm: sklearn.model_selection.TimeSeriesSplit over sorted unique 2023 game dates
chronological_folds.training: expanding dates strictly before validation dates

gates.proper_score_materiality: aggregate candidate-minus-each comparator point and date-block 95% upper bound must each be below negative 1% of comparator Brier and log loss
gates.fold_consistency: candidate Brier and log loss must each improve in every chronological fold versus legacy overlap comparator
gates.discrimination: candidate AUC must be noninferior in every fold and aggregate for HR and Hits separately
gates.survivor_status: development survivor only; must be locked before prospective evidence and cannot be promoted from 2023 folds
